snippet.title: Cozy Builder | Launch Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
The valley is open. Come and see what you make of it.

Cozy Builder is out now on Steam.
➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4059000/Cozy_Builder/

Put the earthquake-damaged châteaux back together one dormer and one gabled roof at a time, then move in and start filling the rooms. The hillsides give you grapes, olives, herbs and wildflowers. What you do with a harvest is yours to decide.

🏚️ Rebuild damaged homes from dormers, arches, gabled roofs and curved glass walls
🛋️ Decorate inside and out, then live in what you built
🍇 Harvest the vineyard and forage the valley
🍷 Make wine, jam and preserves from your own crop
👤 Build a character of your own
👥 Restore the valley together in online co-op
🌤️ No combat, no fail states, no clock

Find all the ways to play:
➤ https://store.indie.io/cozy-builder

More from indie.io:
➤ https://bit.ly/4e91q5q
